en.title: R-A-S-N-M
en.decryption: Remember these as the 1st (Bull), 2nd (Elephant), 3rd (Horse), 22nd (Conch), and 24th (Lion) to tackle matching-type questions.

fact.en: Do not assume all 24 Tirthankaras are historical. Only the 23rd and 24th have clear historical validation.
